A separate prior-200-complete-day trend condition may veto otherwise valid entries when long-horizon price state remains adverse, reducing stale inventory and drawdown without changing an exit.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This task may establish only one post-hoc pre-2025 historical prior for exact same-equity DRA V1 with versus without CURRENT_COMPLETE_UTC_DAY_CLOSE_ABOVE_PRIOR_200_COMPLETE_DAY_SMA admission. Historical Validation is not clean OOS and family selection is non-independent. A positive result is not alpha, a candidate or a runtime filter. The task cannot inspect post-2024 or forward outcomes, change the runner or gate, add another trend horizon or relation, create a hypothesis, manifest, candidate or experiment, open OOS, deploy or authorize Trading.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: The admission veto is valuable only if the same-equity candidate raises total PnL and preserves realized PnL while strictly reducing drawdown, not merely by avoiding participation or moving losses into terminal inventory. Holding tails, underwater duration, annual breadth and contribution concentration must also pass.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: The parent may commit 30-USDT lots while long-horizon trend remains adverse, creating stale capital and drawdown. The candidate can also miss early recoveries and profitable reversals. One frozen comparison can retain the mechanism for later untouched evidence or close the long-trend-filter idea before adapter, OOS, deployment or runtime work consumes capacity.
